title: Jaya Rādhā-Mādhava
summary: A short song to Rādhā-Mādhava, the lovers of Vraja.
about: Glorifies Kṛṣṇa as the lover of the gopīs, the lifter of Govardhana and the wanderer of Vṛndāvana’s forests.
author: Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura

verses.text:
জয় রাধা-মাধব কুঞ্জ-বিহারী
গোপী-জন-বল্লভ গিরি-বর-ধারী
যশোদা-নন্দন ব্রজ-জন-রঞ্জন
যামুনা-তীর-বন-চারী
verses.roman:
jaya rādhā-mādhava kuñja-bihārī
gopī-jana-vallabha giri-vara-dhārī
yaśodā-nandana braja-jana-rañjana
yāmuna-tīra-vana-cārī

sourceHeader.official name: Sri Krsnaer Vimsottara Sata Nama Song 4
sourceHeader.author: Bhaktivinoda Thakura

joined.why: The Roman page splits the one verse of the Bengali page in two.
